question: Should this external hook delivery PR remain blocked until the author provides live multi-account WhatsApp `/hooks/agent` proof, or should a maintainer sponsor a current-main replacement with equivalent proof?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the PR is useful, but the author explicitly did not verify the real delivery path and the branch is both unmergeable and uneditable by maintainers.

options.title: Require refresh and live proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, port the policy to `SourceDeliveryPlan`, remove the changelog edit, update docs, and add redacted live hook delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor replacement
options.body: A maintainer or ClawSweeper replacement PR can preserve the source author's credit while implementing the same fix on current main with proof.

options.title: Pause if no response
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and close this PR later only if the proof ask expires under the stalled-unproven policy.

recommendation.title: Require refresh and live proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, port the policy to `SourceDeliveryPlan`, remove the changelog edit, update docs, and add redacted live hook delivery proof before merge.
